# J.A.R.V.I.S. Obsidian Memory Vault

This folder serves as the permanent, 2-way Obsidian knowledge vault and Life OS for J.A.R.V.I.S.

## Folders
- **`Daily Logs/`**: Contains automated daily logs indexed by date (`YYYY-MM-DD.md`).
- **`Knowledge Base/`**: Stores research briefs, articles, and documentation.
- **`System Context/`**: Persists user facts, hardware profiles, and directives.
- **`skills/`**: Installed official Obsidian agent skills from `kepano/obsidian-skills`.
